text:
Type: chaise sectional sofa
Use: seating, lounging; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: textured woven upholstery, welted seams, dark wood block feet
Colors: warm greige stone, dark brown
Shape: right-facing chaise, sloped track arms, three back cushions, box seats, low block feet, large but clean-lined
Feel: calm, comfortable, neutral
Goes with: wood tones, white or beige walls, soft textiles; transitional or modern family rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Dalton Chaise Sectional Sofa Couch, 91.5", Stone
product.description: Transitional design meets exceptional comfort for everyday living in this sectional sofa. With moisture-repelling and stain-resistant fabric, it can take toddler spills and muddy paw prints, yet still add timeless style to your family room. 91.5"W x 37.5"D x 35"H Solid hardwood and laminate wood frame; polyester/nylon performance fabric Transitional style Crisp, expert tailoring and track arm design built for heavy duty wear No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
